card.name: Digits inside years and dates
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, mostly the second or third digit of a year (1143, 1960s) or a day of the month, in history and general web text.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: A digit partway through a four-digit year or decade, before the remaining digits.

modes.label: Day or page number
modes.description: The first digit of a day of the month or a page range, where more digits and a suffix like th or March follow.

card.writes: It promotes endings like th, pm and am, so it expects a number to finish with an ordinal or time suffix.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a year or date, before the rest of the number is written.
